description: A farmer wants to mix his animal feeds, Feed A and Feed B, in such a way that the mixture will contain a minimum of 30 units of protein and 50 units of fat. Feed A costs $100 per kilogram and contains 10 units of protein and 8 units of fat. Feed B costs $80 per kilogram and contains 7 units of protein and 15 units of fat. Determine the minimum cost of the mixture.

CostFeedA.definition: Cost per kilogram of Feed A

CostFeedB.definition: Cost per kilogram of Feed B

ProteinFeedA.definition: Protein units per kilogram of Feed A

ProteinFeedB.definition: Protein units per kilogram of Feed B

FatFeedA.definition: Fat units per kilogram of Feed A

FatFeedB.definition: Fat units per kilogram of Feed B

MinProtein.definition: Minimum required units of protein in the mixture

MinFat.definition: Minimum required units of fat in the mixture

objective.description: "The goal is to minimize the total cost of the feed mixture while satisfying the minimum protein and fat requirements."

constraints.description: 10 * (Amount of Feed A in kg) + 7 * (Amount of Feed B in kg) >= 30
8 * (Amount of Feed A in kg) + 15 * (Amount of Feed B in kg) >= 50
Amount of Feed A in kg >= 0
Amount of Feed B in kg >= 0

AmountFeedA.definition: Amount of Feed A used in the mixture (in kilograms)

AmountFeedB.definition: Amount of Feed B used in the mixture (in kilograms)
